occurrences.text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
